question: Does the target object's initial side interact with the requested direction?

design.numeric_levels: Candidate cube-minus-bowl lateral offsets are preregistered in absolute-size order 0.10, 0.075, 0.05 m; choose the first symmetric three-level fixture that passes every model-blind row. No behavioral selection is permitted.

exact_prompts.left: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
exact_prompts.right: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.

held_fixed: bowl and banana full initial poses
robot base, cameras, and all nonmovable geometry
checkpoint, preprocessing, controller, cone, action cap, and static prompt bytes
environment and sampling seed within each six-cell block

model_blind_gate.selection_rule: Try absolute cube-minus-bowl lateral offsets 0.10, 0.075, then 0.05 m; choose the first for which right, center, and left levels all pass every feasibility row; otherwise fail closed.
requirements: neither requested relation true at reset
symmetric target displacement about the center level
LEFT/RIGHT physical fingerprints identical at each start level
nonblank camera views and persistent raw writers

analysis_plan.primary: Matched-seed direction-by-target-start-side interaction for requested success and requested-side depth.
analysis_plan.continuous_full_sample: Signed final lateral offset, path length, contact, and cone-entry timing remain defined for failures.
analysis_plan.failure_taxonomy: Report correct/pick/transport/wrong_side/release by start level and direction.
analysis_plan.claim_boundary: A start-side interaction can reflect geometry, reachability, or policy state dependence; it does not isolate training data.

release_boundary.next_action: Register the exact numeric three-level fixture and hash-bound 162-row queue only after the model-blind gate passes.
